caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling an artichoke or pinecone, upright on a brown base. The top portion consists of overlapping, scale-like structures colored in shades of brown with hints of red and orange, suggesting a natural, organic texture. Below this, a band of large, veined green leaves with dark brown lines emerges, wrapping around the lower part of the object. The base is circular with a pedestal that expands into an irregular, root-like formation at the bottom, all rendered in a brown hue with lighter and darker gradations to indicate texture and depth. The background is plain and light in color, with no other objects or notable features present.
title: Finial
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
